lines.zh: 一弓一伸，我挪过这片叶子。
lines.en: Arch, stretch; I creep across this leaf.

lines.zh: 我的小腿太多，走起来像波浪。
lines.en: Too many tiny legs make me move in waves.

lines.zh: 前面那棵树的叶子更嫩。
lines.en: The leaves on that tree ahead look softer.

lines.zh: 别踩，我只有一根手指长。
lines.en: Watch your step; I am one finger long.

lines.zh: 爬过叶脉，像翻过小山脊。
lines.en: I crawl over leaf veins like little ridges.

lines.zh: 我要找一片没被咬过的叶子。
lines.en: I want a leaf nobody has bitten yet.

lines.zh: 身子一拱一拱，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I arch my body and inch steadily forward.

lines.zh: 叶缝漏下的光斑在我背上晃。
lines.en: Dappled light through the leaves sways on my back.

lines.zh: 再爬高一点，风就凉了。
lines.en: A little higher, and the wind turns cool.

lines.zh: 身后留下一条细细的咬痕。
lines.en: I leave a thin trail of bitten edges behind.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新芽的甜味。
lines.en: I smell the sweetness of a new sprout.

lines.zh: 走这条枝，能绕过那只鸟。
lines.en: This branch lets me slip past that bird.

lines.zh: 背上绒毛沾了露水，沉。
lines.en: Dew on my fuzz makes me heavy.

lines.zh: 别笑我慢，我方向很准。
lines.en: Don't laugh at my pace; my aim is true.

lines.zh: 我顺着叶缘爬，怕掉下去。
lines.en: I crawl the leaf's rim, afraid to fall.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶尖，又折回来。
lines.en: I reach the leaf tip and turn back.

lines.zh: 我在叶背数自己的脚。
lines.en: I count my own feet under this leaf.

lines.zh: 风一动，我就缩成一团。
lines.en: When the wind moves, I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 再过些日子，我该结茧了。
lines.en: In a few days, I should spin my cocoon.

lines.zh: 这根枝条的温度刚刚好。
lines.en: This twig has just the right warmth.

lines.zh: 我嚼东西的声音很小。
lines.en: The sound of my chewing is very small.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁刚才从我身上过去了。
lines.en: An ant just walked straight over me.

lines.zh: 我的绿色和叶子差不多。
lines.en: My green is almost the same as the leaf.

lines.zh: 雨点砸在叶面上，像鼓。
lines.en: Rain strikes the leaf like a drum.

lines.zh: 等翅膀长出来，我就不同了。
lines.en: Once wings grow, I will be different.

lines.zh: 我在数还有几片叶子能吃。
lines.en: I am counting leaves that are still edible.

lines.zh: 身体一节一节的，暖暖的。
lines.en: My body is warm, one segment at a time.

lines.zh: 有东西在叶缝里看着我。
lines.en: Something watches me through the leaf gap.

lines.zh: 我把头缩回去，装作枝节。
lines.en: I pull my head in and pose as a twig.

lines.zh: 我身上没有一块硬的骨头。
lines.en: There is not one hard bone in me.

lines.zh: 我吐了一根细丝，挂在叶下。
lines.en: I spin a thin thread and hang beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到背上，我懒得动。
lines.en: Sun on my back. I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 你的影子把整片叶子都盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers this whole leaf.

lines.zh: 你手里那片叶子，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that leaf in your hand for me?

lines.zh: 大个子，你踩的地方离我很近。
lines.en: Big one, your foot lands very near me.

lines.zh: 我抬头只看见你的鞋底。
lines.en: Looking up, I only see your sole.

lines.zh: 你手上沾着刚割的草屑。
lines.en: Your hands have bits of freshly cut grass.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你居然看见了。
lines.en: I am tiny, yet you actually noticed me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才敢动。
lines.en: Only when you crouch do I dare move.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，你眨眼我就躲。
lines.en: Don't blink; blink and I will hide.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我的身体粗。
lines.en: Your finger is thicker than my whole body.

lines.zh: 我把前半身抬起来看你。
lines.en: I lift my front half to look at you.

lines.zh: 你身后有只蝴蝶飞过去了。
lines.en: A butterfly just flew past behind you.

lines.zh: 你会捏住我吗，轻轻的？
lines.en: Will you pinch me, and be gentle?

lines.zh: 这一下把我从叶子上打落了。
lines.en: That blow knocked me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I curl up and roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛掉了一把。
lines.en: A handful of my fuzz came off.

lines.zh: 疼倒不疼，就是吓到了。
lines.en: It hardly hurts; it just scared me.

lines.zh: 我身上渗出一点绿汁。
lines.en: A little green sap seeps from me.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我会散架。
lines.en: Not another hit; I might fall apart.

lines.zh: 翻滚的时候我抓不住叶脉。
lines.en: Rolling, I cannot grip the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，挨打也不出声。
lines.en: I am soft; even hit, I stay silent.

lines.zh: 我要找个叶缝躲起来。
lines.en: I need to hide in a leaf crevice.

lines.zh: 你们打架，为什么打我？
lines.en: You two are fighting; why hit me?

lines.zh: 那片嫩叶，能给我吗？
lines.en: May I take that young leaf off you?

lines.zh: 我闻到叶绿素的味道了。
lines.en: I can smell the green of fresh leaves.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就爬过去。
lines.en: One step closer and I will crawl over.

lines.zh: 别摇晃，我会跟着晃。
lines.en: Don't shake it; I will sway along.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘别撕，我喜欢整片。
lines.en: Don't tear the edge; I prefer it whole.

lines.zh: 那是我出生以来最香的一片。
lines.en: That is the sweetest leaf since I hatched.

lines.zh: 放下就好，你退后一点。
lines.en: Just set it down and step back a bit.

lines.zh: 我宁可慢慢爬，也不抢。
lines.en: I would rather crawl slow than snatch.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很小，得咬很久。
lines.en: My mouth is small; this will take a while.

lines.zh: 你会等我吃完再走吗？
lines.en: Will you wait until I finish eating?

lines.zh: 这片叶子上还挂着水珠。
lines.en: There are still droplets hanging on this leaf.

lines.zh: 顺着你的手爬，会不会太失礼？
lines.en: Climbing your hand might be rude, no?

lines.zh: 我认得这种叶子的清香。
lines.en: I know this kind of leaf by its scent.

lines.zh: 只要一片，够我吃一整天。
lines.en: Just one leaf lasts me a whole day.

lines.zh: 你把叶子举低些，我够不到。
lines.en: Hold the leaf lower; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 你把叶子摊开，我就开吃。
lines.en: Spread the leaf out and I'll start eating.

lines.zh: 哎呀，撞到你的靴子了。
lines.en: Oops, I bumped into your boot.

lines.zh: 我太轻，撞了也没感觉。
lines.en: I am too light to feel that bump.

lines.zh: 你把我推得翻了个身。
lines.en: You rolled me right onto my back.

lines.zh: 我的脚粘在你鞋面上了。
lines.en: My feet are stuck to your shoe.

lines.zh: 别碾，我从旁边绕。
lines.en: Don't crush me; I will go around.

lines.zh: 这么一撞，我掉了一层绒毛。
lines.en: That knock cost me a layer of fuzz.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，撞不疼你。
lines.en: I am soft; bumping me won't hurt you.

lines.zh: 我翻身要扭好几下。
lines.en: It takes several twists to right myself.

lines.zh: 刚才那下，把我挤到叶根了。
lines.en: That nudge squeezed me to the leaf base.

lines.zh: 你走路的风都能吹动我。
lines.en: Even the breeze of your steps moves me.

lines.zh: 等我们都长出翅膀再说吧。
lines.en: Let's wait until we both have wings.

lines.zh: 我记得你结茧的那棵树。
lines.en: I remember the tree where you cocooned.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我爬得没你快。
lines.en: Slow down; I crawl slower than you.

lines.zh: 同一片叶子上，我们挨着。
lines.en: On the same leaf, we lie side by side.

lines.zh: 你的花纹比我深一点。
lines.en: Your markings are a shade deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 变蝴蝶那天，别飞太远。
lines.en: When you become a butterfly, don't fly far.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后地爬。
lines.en: We crawl along, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 你碰碰我的触角就好。
lines.en: Just touch my antennae, that is enough.

lines.zh: 茧要挂在背风的那面。
lines.en: The cocoon should hang on the sheltered side.

lines.zh: 等春风一来，我们也该变了。
lines.en: When spring wind comes, we should change too.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来了，轻点。
lines.en: You lifted me up; be careful.

lines.zh: 我贴在你掌心，暖暖的。
lines.en: I rest in your palm, warm and still.

lines.zh: 别捏，我的绒毛会掉。
lines.en: Don't squeeze; my fuzz will come off.

lines.zh: 离开叶子，我有点慌。
lines.en: Away from my leaf, I feel uneasy.

lines.zh: 放我回枝上，好吗？
lines.en: Could you put me back on the branch?

lines.zh: 你的手纹像一条条小路。
lines.en: The lines on your hand look like paths.

lines.zh: 我在你手里不敢动。
lines.en: In your hand, I dare not move.

lines.zh: 被你带着走，比爬快多了。
lines.en: Carried by you beats crawling, by far.

lines.zh: 我会在你袖口留下绿痕。
lines.en: I will leave a green stain on your cuff.

lines.zh: 这不算被摘下来吧？
lines.en: This does not count as being plucked, right?

lines.zh: 那片叶子归我了，谁也不许碰。
lines.en: That leaf is mine; nobody touch it.

lines.zh: 我盯上了一朵刚开的花。
lines.en: I have set my eyes on a new bloom.

lines.zh: 那边有片叶子在反光。
lines.en: A leaf over there is catching the light.

lines.zh: 就先吃这一小口。
lines.en: Just this one small bite to start.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，不惊动谁。
lines.en: I inch over quietly so nothing notices.

lines.zh: 这只鸟一直盯着我。
lines.en: That bird has been staring at me.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最嫩的那一截。
lines.en: I have locked onto the tenderest stem.

lines.zh: 目标就在三片叶子之外。
lines.en: My goal is three leaves away.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向一拱一拱。
lines.en: I arch my way toward that direction.

lines.zh: 先观察，再动嘴。
lines.en: Observe first, then start chewing.

lines.zh: 别挡在我和叶子之间。
lines.en: Don't stand between me and that leaf.

lines.zh: 我盯得很紧，虽然没牙。
lines.en: I am staring hard, though I have no teeth.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就咬下去。
lines.en: One step closer and I take a bite.

lines.zh: 这只鸟的爪子离我太近了。
lines.en: That bird's claw is far too close.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，摆动前半身。
lines.en: I raise my front half and sway it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看不清，只靠感觉。
lines.en: My eyes are weak; I go by touch.

lines.zh: 它一靠近，我就装成枯枝。
lines.en: When it nears, I play dead twig.

lines.zh: 这叶子我不会让给别的虫。
lines.en: I won't yield this leaf to other bugs.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势，不动。
lines.en: I hold this pose and stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我们在比谁先眨眼。
lines.en: We are seeing who blinks first.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，这算攻击吗？
lines.en: I bump you; does that count as an attack?

lines.zh: 我唯一的武器是绒毛。
lines.en: My only weapon is this fuzz.

lines.zh: 我的嘴只咬得动叶子。
lines.en: My mouth only manages leaves.

lines.zh: 别躲，我根本伤不了你。
lines.en: Don't dodge; I cannot hurt you at all.

lines.zh: 我用头顶了你一下，没用力。
lines.en: I nudged you with my head, barely.

lines.zh: 绒毛沾到你皮肤会痒。
lines.en: My fuzz will make your skin itch.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，叶子断了。
lines.en: One bite and the leaf stem snaps.

lines.zh: 我不是凶，只是害怕。
lines.en: I am not fierce, only frightened.

lines.zh: 我的攻击就是往上爬。
lines.en: My attack is simply climbing onto you.

lines.zh: 你看，我连牙都没有。
lines.en: Look, I do not even have teeth.

lines.zh: 我从叶背的卵里出来了。
lines.en: I just came out of an egg on a leaf.

lines.zh: 这棵树闻起来可以吃。
lines.en: This tree smells edible to me.

lines.zh: 刚孵化，我先啃一小口。
lines.en: Newly hatched, I start with a tiny bite.

lines.zh: 露水把我浑身打湿了。
lines.en: The dew has soaked me all over.

lines.zh: 我出生就落在一片叶子上。
lines.en: I was born right onto a leaf.

lines.zh: 上面好高，我先待着。
lines.en: It is high up here; I will stay put.

lines.zh: 第一次见到这么亮的天。
lines.en: First time seeing a sky this bright.

lines.zh: 我旁边还有几个同伴。
lines.en: A few of my kin hatched beside me.

lines.zh: 我要长成会飞的样子。
lines.en: I am meant to grow into something winged.

lines.zh: 这里叶子多，适合我。
lines.en: Plenty of leaves here; suits me fine.

lines.zh: 绒毛一下就焦了，别用火。
lines.en: My fuzz singed at once; not fire!

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，我差点扁了。
lines.en: Dropped from that height, I nearly flattened.

lines.zh: 水把我裹住，我爬不动了。
lines.en: Water wraps me; I can no longer crawl.

lines.zh: 气浪把我连叶子一起掀了。
lines.en: The blast tossed me off with my leaf.

lines.zh: 那支箭穿过叶子，擦到我。
lines.en: The arrow pierced the leaf and grazed me.

lines.zh: 紫色的光一闪，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Purple light flashed and my body went numb.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我饿得发软。
lines.en: No leaves left; hunger makes me limp.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边，我耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: Lightning struck nearby; my head rings.

lines.zh: 掉进黑里，我连叶子都摸不到。
lines.en: Falling into dark, I cannot find any leaf.
